sentences.text: Methanoprimaticola is an archaeal genus proposed as new within the order Methanomassiliicoccales, in the newly named family Methanomethylophilaceae.
It was described in a survey of archaea in methane-emitting arthropods that combined phylogenomic analysis of isolates and metagenome-assembled genomes with full-length 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing.
A genome catalog of the human gut archaeome reported Methanoprimaticola sp905187815 as one of nine core differential species, depleted in inflammatory bowel disease.
That catalog study reported that profiling 11,818 metagenomes revealed distinct archaeome variations linked to geography, gender and age.
